original_test_intent: Drive the exact BMC SEL through its supported full/overflow boundary under a bounded approved stimulus and verify specified non-SEL IPMI commands still execute normally without losing diagnostic evidence.
original_method: Export baseline SEL/host/BMC evidence and capacity/overflow status, obtain approval for a vendor-supported finite fill stimulus, monitor every increment to the defined full condition, stop at the boundary, run an approved matrix of read-only IPMI commands and preserve post-state/recovery evidence.
manual_activity: The owner/vendor supplies and approves the supported fill method, capacity/overflow semantics, post-full command matrix and cleanup; an operator monitors BMC health and event retention.
required_inputs: Exact BMC/firmware/SEL capacity, allocation/overflow mode and current occupancy
Supported event-generation/fill mechanism with event type, finite count/rate and expected entry size
Definition of full/exceeds-max and expected retention/overwrite/overflow flags
Specific other ipmitool commands and normal exit/output contract
Independent recovery plus post-export cleanup/restore procedure
safety_requirements: Export/hash all existing SEL, BMC, dmesg and syslog evidence; do not clear logs
Require explicit approval for the bounded state-changing stimulus
Never invent event injection or loop until full; calculate maximum finite attempts from capacity contract
Stop on unexpected overwrite, uncontrolled generation, BMC/host instability or management loss
Keep validation commands read-only; perform cleanup only after evidence export and separate approval
agent_execution_scope: Collect immutable baseline SEL info/entries/free/flags and representative command outputs
After approval, execute only the finite vendor stimulus while recording each entry/capacity transition
Stop at the approved full/overflow boundary and run the exact read-only post-full command matrix
Compare exits/outputs and BMC health, export evidence and support approved cleanup
Make no arbitrary injection, clear, retry or independent DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Provide/approve stimulus, full/overflow semantics, stop limit and post-command matrix
Approve cleanup/recovery only after complete export and supervise abnormal state
Review transition and command evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: sel info is necessary observation but cannot create the full condition or test other commands. Source lacks a fill command, so one must come from vendor/owner rather than invention; source log clearing is replaced by export/preserve.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Execute a signed finite vendor stimulus manifest from preserved baseline to the defined full boundary, capture capacity/overflow after each step, then run the approved read-only command matrix and recover only under owner control.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exceeds-max SEL condition, other ipmitool behavior, unexpected-log inspection and 10/10-minute estimates remain; no specific fill command is fabricated.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Precompute the finite stimulus budget from baseline occupancy and vendor entry-sizing rules, capture an append-only transition ledger and distinguish reject-new versus overwrite-old overflow policies before evaluating command continuity.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces destructive log clearing and unspecified filling with preserved baseline, finite approved stimulus, exact boundary/overflow semantics and controlled cleanup.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A sel info snapshot can show capacity but not how the BMC crosses/exceeds it or whether unrelated IPMI commands remain usable at full state.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SEL exhaustion may overwrite safety-relevant events or impair future logging. Entry sizes/policies can be platform-specific, so event count and cleanup cannot be guessed.

project_override_considerations: If firmware uses wrap/overwrite rather than a hard full state, engineering must map the source's exceeds-max condition to the exact flag/retention behavior and retain the post-full IPMI command checks.
expected_evidence: Exact source row/variant/hash and BMC/firmware/IPMI/SEL policy identity
Exported baseline logs/hashes, occupancy/free/capacity/overflow flags and command baseline
Owner/vendor approval and exact finite stimulus count/rate/event audit
Per-step occupancy/overflow/retention transition to approved full boundary
Post-full specified IPMI command outputs/exit statuses and BMC/host health
Post-export cleanup/recovery, no-log-clear/no-auto-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria coherently require SEL exhaustion followed by normal IPMI execution. The missing fill method/capacity policy are project package inputs; DeepSeek's read-only shortcut is incomplete rather than authoritative conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Execution depends on a vendor-approved stimulus and recovery plan, but the static review is complete and missing package is not counted as DUT failure.

review_improvement: Restores the source's actual capacity-boundary stimulus and post-full command coverage while protecting the diagnostic history that the source proposed clearing.
independent_technical_reasoning: SEL-full behavior depends on allocation and overflow policy: firmware may reject new entries, set an overflow flag or overwrite old ones. Each has different evidence and risk, so 'entries/free' is not a universal oracle. The finite stimulus budget must be derived before execution because an until-full loop can continue through overwrite mode indefinitely. Normal post-full execution also needs a named command matrix with exit/status semantics; a responsive BMC or successful sel info alone does not prove general IPMI continuity.
